Virashaiva tradition traces itself to five founding teachers, Renuka, Daruka, Ghantakarna, Dhenukarna and Vishvakarna, said to have issued from five lingas and to preside over five seats. Its philosophical position is Shaktivishishtadvaita, a qualified non-dualism of God and Shakti, and the Ashtavarana are its eight observances, the guru, linga, jangama, padodaka, prasada, vibhuti, rudraksha and mantra, that shield the devotee.

Kashmir Shaivism, the Trika system, is traced to Vasugupta of the early ninth century, to whom the Shiva Sutras are attributed. Abhinavagupta was its greatest expositor some two centuries later rather than its founder.

Four Stars of Destiny is the autobiography of General Manoj Mukund Naravane, who served as Chief of the Army Staff from 2019 to 2022, the title alluding to the four stars of a full general's rank.

The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership binds the ten ASEAN states to their existing free trade partners, namely China, Japan, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand. India took part in the negotiations but withdrew in November 2019 over concerns about import surges and the trade deficit with China.

The Bharat Ratna was instituted in January 1954, not 1972. It carries no monetary grant, the recipient receiving only a Sanad signed by the President and a peepal-leaf shaped medallion.
